senses.gloss:
उल्-लेख, अस्, m. description; (in rhetoric) de-
scription of an object according to the different
impressions caused by its appearance^1; speaking, utter-
ance, pronunciation.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210422. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/60.

उल्-लेख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be scraped or pared;
to be written.
